attempts.sql: SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count FROM code.files f WHERE f.package = 'rich' AND f.module NOT LIKE '%/%' AND f.line_count >= 100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files t WHERE t.is_test AND t.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '^(.*/)?([^/]+)\.py$', '\1test_\2.py')) ORDER BY f.file_id

request:
Which Python files sitting directly in the rich/ folder (not in its subfolders) are at least 100 lines long yet have no test file associated with them, where a test is associated when it imports the file or its name is test_<filename>.py? Give the file path and its line count.

Requested output columns: file_id (string), line_count (integer).
explanation: Selects non-test Python files whose package is 'rich' and whose module has no slash (i.e., directly in rich/), with at least 100 lines. It excludes files that are imported by any file and files for which a sibling test_<filename>.py exists.
sql: SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count FROM code.files f WHERE f.package = 'rich' AND f.module NOT LIKE '%/%' AND f.line_count >= 100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files t WHERE t.is_test AND t.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '^(.*/)?([^/]+)\.py$', '\1test_\2.py')) ORDER BY f.file_id
